assumptions.statement: Official regulatory controls, heritage zones, road redlines, parcels, utilities, electrical capacity, fire conditions, existing buildings, current charge/swap points, and engineering constraints are unavailable in the public package.
assumptions.impact: Spatial and construction content remains conceptual; no statutory, ownership, demolition, or engineering conclusion may be made.

assumptions.statement: The site and three key-area polygons are rough repository geometry inferred from public descriptions and approximate areas. Reproducible community checks in repository Issue #1029 report that provisional PROV-KEY-003 is internally area/order-consistent but centred near Beijing North Station, about 2.26 km from Dazhongsi metro; this is not an official replacement boundary or permission to shift it.
assumptions.impact: The package keeps upstream geometry only as a placeholder and treats Dazhongsi as the programme name from the brief, not a verified map anchor. All real sites require separate verification; canonical or official geometry must trigger whole-package recalculation.

assumptions.statement: The 2018 Dazhongsi smart charging-cabinet report is historical evidence only; no cabinet is assumed to exist, operate, or comply in 2026.
assumptions.impact: Every current point, model, acceptance record, operator and state must be field- or operator-verified before it appears as an implementation site.

assumptions.statement: No charge/swap operator, safety-accountable entity, site/property manager, parking manager or emergency-stop authority is assumed to have committed.
assumptions.impact: A real pilot cannot open until written responsibility, insurance, 24-hour contact, inspection, incident and battery-retirement duties are confirmed.

assumptions.statement: Electrical and fire protection, local isolation and emergency shutdown never depend on a cloud model or AI inference.
assumptions.impact: Only compliant equipment and deterministic local protection may carry safety functions; AI may assist demand and work-order analysis only.

assumptions.statement: The minimum event model contains no rider name, phone, identity, home/work address, order, employer, platform account, face, licence plate or continuous trajectory field.
assumptions.impact: Discovery of such a field is a stop condition; demand uses aggregate time bands and images are not required for the MVP.

assumptions.statement: The Stop-Charge Responsibility Station, Open Tariff Hall, Fail-safe Test Bench and parking-management handover are study nodes, not confirmed sites or equipment locations.
assumptions.impact: Field survey, ownership, operator consent, power, fire, accessibility, drainage, traffic and evacuation checks are required before siting.

assumptions.statement: The 90-day schedule, hours, demand bands, response targets, cost ceiling, and continuation thresholds are proposed for joint confirmation.
assumptions.impact: The pilot may shrink, pause, or stop if operator, electrical, fire, privacy, labour, tariff, cost or safety gates are not met.

assumptions.statement: Zhongzhiyuan tests use test benches, synthetic fault events and non-energised or professionally isolated equipment until safety review permits otherwise.
assumptions.impact: No unverified battery or charger is introduced; reproducibility, local shutdown and human overrides are reported.

assumptions.statement: Individuals may park, charge or swap through the authorised service and report faults, but do not accept, transport, dismantle, repair or dispose of unknown batteries.
assumptions.impact: Government, community and volunteers also do not replace the professional operator's product-safety and battery-lifecycle responsibility.
